skills.name: design-taste-frontend
skills.description: Design and implement distinctive landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns by inferring audience, visual direction, and an appropriate design system. Use when a marketing-facing web surface needs original frontend craft or a Taste design contract. Do not use for dashboards, data tables, or multi-step product application UI.

skills.name: surface-refresh-audit
skills.description: Audit and improve an existing product surface while preserving its established design direction and functionality. Use when a shipped interface needs a focused refresh, redesign, or anti-slop pass. Do not use for a first build or for backend behavior changes.

skills.name: takyon-app-runtime
skills.description: Configure and verify a business application's declared customer-facing runtime features and real signed-in actions. Use when auth, profiles, plans, entitlements, checkout, usage, or actions must be wired and proven through existing rails. Do not use to administer real customers, forge payment/webhook state, or perform purely visual layout work.

skills.name: takyon-autonomous-seo-geo-operator
skills.description: Audit and improve one business web surface for honest search and AI-answer visibility. Use when a small, reviewable pass should improve metadata, schema, internal links, sitemap, robots, llms.txt, or a few strategic bottom-of-funnel pages. Do not use for off-page promotion, fabricated evidence, mass programmatic pages, or guaranteed ranking claims.

skills.name: takyon-brand-logo
skills.description: Create a business-scoped icon-only brand mark with a transparent background. Use when a product, site, app, or social profile needs a real logo mark. Do not use for naming, brand voice, generic imagery, performance ads, photo editing, or video.

skills.name: takyon-business-metrics
skills.description: Compute, summarize, and track canonical business metrics, wake history, and unresolved inbound state. Use when running every wake, establishing the first creation baseline, or when users, revenue, usage, or replies materially affect the next move. Do not use to invent strategy from missing measurements.

skills.name: takyon-distribution
skills.description: Plan and coordinate honest cross-channel demand creation, campaign artifacts, outreach lanes, and campaign continuation for one business. Use when distribution work spans channels or needs an operating plan. Do not use for channel-native X, Reddit, or paid-ad execution, or for product-surface changes.

skills.name: takyon-lightreel-seedance-fal-ugc
skills.description: Turn business facts into a single-person creator-format research brief, a Seedance-safe prompt, and a fal-compatible render payload. Use when a UGC concept needs evidence-informed creator direction before video generation. Do not use for secret handling, product UI work, screen recordings, product-shot videos, or multi-actor ads.

skills.name: takyon-market-research
skills.description: Gather and synthesize current customer, competitor, channel, pricing, and demand evidence for one business. Use when evidence is weak or stale or when positioning, audience, offer, pricing, or channel decisions need fresh truth. Do not use for cosmetic copy changes that do not change a business decision.

skills.name: takyon-meta-ads-v2
skills.description: Launch, control, measure, and verify Meta campaigns from finished real creative, including pixel readiness and evidence-backed performance evaluation. Use when an existing image or video is ready for Meta execution or an existing campaign needs operation. Do not use to create media, fabricate attribution, hard-delete campaigns, or bypass missing authority.

skills.name: takyon-mobile-app
skills.description: Build, verify, compliance-check, and release an iOS application for a mobile-app business. Use when real mobile source is missing, starter-shaped, or needs a focused pass, or when a verified build should move through TestFlight or App Store submission. Do not use for web products, shared backend runtime ownership, or archetype selection.

skills.name: takyon-product
skills.description: Build or improve one business web product, including its public landing surface and real signed-in customer workflow, then verify the build and publication result. Use when the product is missing, starter-shaped, incomplete, or needs a focused iteration. Do not use for market research, channel distribution, or backend-rail invention.

skills.name: takyon-reddit-ads
skills.description: Launch, control, and measure Reddit campaigns from a real promoted post, public creative URL, or existing business media asset. Use when finished creative is ready for Reddit paid distribution, authentication and account discovery is needed, or a live campaign needs operation. Do not use to create media, fabricate URLs, or claim unsupported attribution.

skills.name: takyon-static-ad-creative-generator
skills.description: Design and generate business-scoped static performance-ad image variants from a factual brief. Use when Meta, Instagram, Facebook, or Reddit needs reviewable image-ad angles, specs, prompts, and real renders. Do not use for logos, generic art, video, long-form copy, or live ad-account operation and measurement.

skills.name: takyon-x
skills.description: Draft, publish, review, and continue authentic X posts, replies, threads, and durable voice for one business. Use when distribution work is specifically X-shaped, including a wake or campaign turn, or X conversation handling is required. Do not use for broad cross-channel coordination or for pretending an external post succeeded without authoritative evidence.

skills.name: taste-imagegen-web
skills.description: Art-direct generated imagery and visual references for a web surface from its business and design brief. Use when an interface genuinely needs page-role-specific original imagery. Do not use for generic filler, direct provider calls, logos, ad creative, or image generation unrelated to a web surface.

skills.name: ugc-video-ad
skills.description: Create a short business-scoped vertical talking-head UGC video ad with coordinated dialogue, action, reference imagery, continuity, and finishing. Use when a business needs a real social video advertisement. Do not use for screen recordings, product demos, multi-actor videos, non-business media, or fabricated completion.
